name: Cinematic Film Still
tagline: You as the lead in a widescreen movie frame.
description: Twelve original movie scenes with you in the lead: neo-noir rain, a late-night diner, a desert road movie, a period ballroom, a space station, a heist, a 70s thriller and a stormy lighthouse. Widescreen frames, anamorphic flares and film grades that look like a still from the trailer.
